boundaries.editor: CodeMirror editor mounted by LiveCodeSandboxProvider in the Storybook preview boundary
boundaries.preview: react-live LiveProvider and LivePreview render the last successful composition inside the provider
boundaries.runtimeScope: LiveCodeScope is the explicit name-to-value namespace supplied to react-live; it is not a component catalog
boundaries.registry: LiveCodeRegistryItem metadata controls visible, selectable examples and prop suggestions; it is not the runtime namespace
boundaries.storage: LiveCodeSandboxStorage is persisted under the caller-provided storageKey and synchronized through browser or Storybook channel events
boundaries.managerCommunication: Only the documented open and synchronization events cross the Storybook channel boundary
